Simon / Emma — great conversation this morning. Thanks for the time.

Attached is a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that captures the milestones we discussed, a proposed target close date, and the list of owners we flagged on the call. Key asks below: 

- Please confirm the owners for the four primary tracks: Economic buyer, Security owner, Legal owner, Eng lead.
- Confirm the target close of June 30, 2027 as still realistic for your procurement timeline.
- Highlight any dependencies we should add to the plan (3rd-party approvals, PoC infra, procurement windows).

Attachments: DataForge_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (high-level controls summary we referenced).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm owners in-line;
2) Karthik will follow up with an eng checklist for the PoC (KV cache/latency targets) by EOD Tuesday;
3) If owners confirmed, we’ll convert the MAP to a shared Google Sheet and request sign-off from the economic buyer.

If helpful I can set a 15-min alignment call to walk through the MAP with your security and procurement owners.

Thanks — look forward to the confirmation.

Best,

Ben — thanks for the recap and the clear MAP. On owners:

- Economic buyer: I (Simon Clark) will be the final approver on budget, but CFO sign-off will be required for procurement.
- Security owner: Emma Ruiz is our security lead and should be the primary reviewer.
- Legal owner: We will route to in-house counsel (cc’ing a contact, but she’s out until next week); temporary contact for contract questions: legal@dataforge.com.
- Eng lead: Priya Natarajan (Priya.N@dataforge.com) will own the PoC and technical sign-off.

Dependencies to note:
- Our security team requires an architecture diagram + expected data flows before they can complete the controls review (Emma will confirm specific artifacts).
- Procurement has a quarterly cutoff on May 15 for initial purchase orders if we want to be in the June billing cycle — otherwise finance pushes to the next month.

Target close: June 30 is still our internal goal, but it’s contingent on procurement hitting the May 15 window or otherwise accepting a July start.

I can confirm owners in the shared sheet once you publish it. Also please have Karthik send the PoC checklist; Priya will review it.
